pack.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 — function baseline
pack.jurisdiction: International voluntary use; published by NIST (United States)
coverage: top-level readiness for GOVERN, IDENTIFY, PROTECT, DETECT, RESPOND and RECOVER
known_gaps: This pack does not encode every CSF 2.0 category and subcategory.
It does not supply an organisational Current or Target Profile.
Implementation tiers and informative references require separate profiles.
pack.notice: CSF 2.0 is voluntary. Findings describe profile gaps, not legal non-compliance.

anchors.summary: CSF 2.0 organises cybersecurity outcomes into six concurrent Functions: GOVERN, IDENTIFY, PROTECT, DETECT, RESPOND and RECOVER.
Current and Target Profiles support gap analysis and prioritisation.
